guide.framing_summary: For this Story: the rhythm of days on the trail together, the immensity of the mountains around you, and the quiet moments that made the trek yours.

dimensions.label: Trail & terrain
dimensions.purpose: The physical reality of the trek — paths, passes, weather, elevation — that gives the journey its shape and weight across eight days.

capture_possibilities.label: The trail ahead or behind
capture_possibilities.semantic_purpose: Conveys distance, progress, and the scale of what you're walking through.

capture_possibilities.label: A col or high point
capture_possibilities.semantic_purpose: Marks a turning point or hard-won arrival in the day's effort.

capture_possibilities.label: Changing conditions
capture_possibilities.semantic_purpose: Rain, mist, golden light — the weather that colored a particular day.

dimensions.label: Togetherness on the move
dimensions.purpose: The shared experience of trekking as a group — walking together, encouraging each other, the companionship that defines 'our' trek.

capture_possibilities.label: Walking together
capture_possibilities.semantic_purpose: The simple image of your group in motion on the trail.

capture_possibilities.label: A shared reaction
capture_possibilities.semantic_purpose: A laugh, a look, a moment of awe experienced side by side.

dimensions.label: Rest & refuge
dimensions.purpose: The counterpoint to the trail — huts, meals, end-of-day relief — where the reflective tone lives and the group reconnects.

capture_possibilities.label: Arriving at a refuge
capture_possibilities.semantic_purpose: The satisfaction of reaching shelter after a day's walk.

capture_possibilities.label: A quiet evening moment
capture_possibilities.semantic_purpose: Tired contentment — food, rest, conversation winding down.

dimensions.label: Scale of Mont Blanc
dimensions.purpose: The massif itself — glaciers, rock faces, vast valleys — the grandeur that makes this trek singular and not just any hike.

capture_possibilities.label: The massif revealed
capture_possibilities.semantic_purpose: A moment where the sheer size of the mountains fills the frame.

capture_possibilities.label: People dwarfed by landscape
capture_possibilities.semantic_purpose: Puts the human journey in proportion to the alpine world.

guide.framing_summary: For this Story: the stillness and scale of the mountains, held in a few calm, unhurried moments.

guide.framing_summary: For this Story: the weight of stillness in the mountains, the vast space around a single figure, and the quiet that settles when no one else is there.
